question: Which set of tattvas is intended to be pervaded in this ritual stage?
premises: The tattvas named Ātman, Vidyā, and Śiva are specified.
Pervasion of these tattvas is prescribed.
This pervasion is the intended ritual aim.
inference: The pervasion of the tattvas named Ātman, Vidyā, and Śiva is intended.
plain_english: The pervasion of the tattvas named Ātman, Vidyā, and Śiva is intended.
